description: Client-side script for the 'Account' doctype in ERPNext, managing form behaviors such as setup, refresh, account type handling, toolbar buttons, merging accounts, and updating account numbers.

classes.name: frappe.ui.Dialog
classes.description: Dialog class used for merge and update account number operations.

methods.name: merge_account
methods.description: Opens a dialog to merge the current account with an existing account and performs the merge operation.

methods.name: update_account_number
methods.description: Opens a dialog to update the account's name and number, then saves the changes.
